items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: One of the main things, I was supposed to be in the show, Eddy Bearfield. He says Cozy, what I want to do is get this show going on Broadway, get a big band, he said, and put all my friends to work

ctx.x: What was the name of the show?

The name of the show was Mr. Tom, and it was a regular, it was built around Uncle Tom's Cabin, and he says Cozy, a lot of people just thought that Uncle Tom was a regular Uncle Tom. He was a humanitarian. And it was

the truth that what he had in all the dialogue, these people were really interested in it, and it was going to be a big Broadway production, I imagine it would have been by now if he had lived. But the interest was lost after he left, and he wrote the music and all the lyrics and everything for it. And the music was just beautiful, all original things of his. And it's so, I felt so sorry that he passed before it all came to light, you know.
